question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(s.avg_loss_rate, 4) as average_loss_rate,
    COUNT(*) as total_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as items_below_avg,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as items_above_avg,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= (s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) 
             AND v."loss_rate_%" <= (s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as items_within_one_std
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV_POP("loss_rate_%") as stddev_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
) s
GROUP BY s.avg_loss_rate, s.stddev_loss_rate
